correctness.rationale: Proved necessity and sufficiency from peripheral vertices seeing only their own blade and the center. Center black: for ell<m no blade may contain >ell white vertices; for ell>=m exactly f<=floor(ell/m) wholly white blades are permitted. Center white requires one black peripheral initiator with w_j+1<=ell. This yields the stated A_{m,ell} and (1+x)^m-1 enumerators, with ell=rm all nonempty sets. Independent direct parallel forcing simulation checked 113,280 individual initial-state/parameter cases across r=2..3, m=2..4, all 1<=ell<=rm. Infinite formulas follow structurally, not by finite tests.

value.rationale: Generalized windmills are standard clique-bouquet graphs, and this is a natural all-threshold/all-initial-set propagation classification rather than one scalar bound. The combinatorial generating function and exact transition at multiples of blade size permit analyses unavailable from previously known friendship-graph zero-forcing numbers.

scientific_limitations: Equal-sized clique blades only, no unequal-blade theorem.
The computation is a finite corroboration; general proof is the blade-wise forcing argument.
